🎃 **Halloween Update Incoming - Unlock New Map This Weekend!** 🎃 

**EARLY ACCESS**
 
Pixel Dungeon: Multiplayer is an interactive RPG action adventure dungeon  exploration game with captivating pixel art style. Grab your weapons and venture into randomly generated ancient dungeons for a thrilling adventure. Explore endless excitement on this heart-pounding epic adventure!


# 👐 Solo or Co-op
Solo exploration or 3-player team-up. Co-op multiplayer enhances your social experience with smarter battle strategies, real-time teammate guidance, and integrated voice chat for seamless coordination.
{501260475750498}

# 🕌 Endless Dungeons
Explore randomly generated dungeons in the pixel world, offering a new challenge with each epic adventure. Discover elite rooms, intricate mazes, and easter egg chambers!
{529726352917073}

# ⚔️ Immersive Combat Experience
Real-time combat and interactive physics simulation bring unparalleled realism. Choose, mix and match from 10+ weapons—snipe with a crossbow, wield a heavy sword, throw axes, wield a magic wand... time your moves to stun enemies and collaborate with teammates to defeat bosses!

{800520695395948}

# 🐱‍👤 Diverse Avatars
Start with 10 avatars, with more designs to be determined by players. Unleash your imagination and share your ideas in Discord!

# 🌟 Growth System
- **Talent**: Utilize the talent system to upgrade different abilities, enhance combat prowess, unlock new skills and items.
- **Weapon Crafting**: Forge your own legendary gear by upgrading weapons or rerolling their attributes.
